Gâteau au chocolat  Biscuit moelleux au cacao • 100 g de farine • 25 g de cacao non sucré • 100 g de sucre • 2 œufs • 70 g de lait • 70 g de beurre fondu • 1 c. à soupe de crème fraîche épaisse ou de fromage blanc • 5 g de levure chimique • 1 pincée de sel Préchauffer le four à 170°C. Fouetter les œufs avec le sucre jusqu’à obtenir un mélange homogène. Ajouter le beurre fondu tiédi ainsi que la cuillère à soupe de crème fraîche ou de fromage blanc. Mélanger. Ajouter ensuite le lait. Tamiser ensemble la farine, le cacao et la levure, puis les incorporer avec la pincée de sel. Mélanger juste assez pour obtenir une pâte homogène. Verser dans un moule de 18 cm et cuire environ 25 à 30 minutes. Le Sirop  • 80 g d’eau • 30 g de sucre • 8 g de cacao non sucré Verser tous les ingrédients dans une petite casserole et faire chauffer à feu moyen en mélangeant jusqu’à ce que le sucre et le cacao soient bien dissous. À la sortie du four, imbiber généreusement le gâteau encore chaud avec le sirop. Ganache chocolat  • 270 g de chocolat  • 190 g de crème liquide entière • 30 g de beurre Faire chauffer la crème jusqu’à frémissement. La verser sur le chocolat préalablement haché et laisser reposer 1 minute. Mélanger progressivement jusqu’à obtenir une ganache parfaitement lisse. Ajouter le beurre et mélanger jusqu’à ce qu’il soit complètement incorporé. Verser sur gâteau. Placer au réfrigérateur jusqu’à ce que la ganache soit bien prise. 🇬🇧 Chocolate Cake Soft Cocoa Cake • 100 g flour  • 25 g unsweetened cocoa powder  • 100 g sugar  • 2 eggs  • 70 g milk  • 70 g melted butter  • 1 tbsp heavy cream or fromage blanc  • 5 g baking powder  • 1 pinch of salt Preheat the oven to 170°C. Whisk the eggs with the sugar until well combined. Add the cooled melted butter and the tablespoon of heavy cream or fromage blanc. Mix. Then add the milk. Sift together the flour, cocoa powder and baking powder, then add them along with the pinch of salt. Mix just until you obtain a smooth batter. Pour into an 18 cm cake pan and bake for approximately 25 to 30 minutes. Syrup • 80 g water  • 30 g sugar  • 8 g unsweetened cocoa powder Pour all the ingredients into a small saucepan and heat over medium heat, stirring until the sugar and cocoa powder are completely dissolved. As soon as the cake comes out of the oven, generously soak it with the syrup while still hot. Chocolate Ganache • 270 g chocolate  • 190 g heavy cream  • 30 g butter Heat the cream until it starts to simmer. Pour it over the chopped chocolate and let it sit for 1 minute. Gradually mix until you obtain a perfectly smooth ganache. Add the butter and mix until fully incorporated. Pour over the cake. Place in the refrigerator until the ganache is completely set.

„Гарячий шоколад“ (Chocolat Chaud) — прямо з мого кулінарного блокноту. У Парижі за одну чашку цього напою платять стільки ж, скільки за повноцінний обід ;) ⠀ ep.17, s.1 ⠀ Інгредієнти (на 1 чашку):  • Чорний шоколад (від 70%) — пів чашки  • Молоко — 1 чашка  • Цукор — за смаком  • Теплі спеції: ≈ кориця, аніс, кардамон, гвоздика  • Ваніль  • Червоний перець — дрібка  • Сіль — дрібка ⠀ Приготування: 1. Інфузуйте молоко: додайте спеції та ваніль — прогрійте до появи пари (80°), не доводячи до кипіння; 2. Розтопіть подрібнений шоколад із цукром і частиною теплого молока; 3. Додайте: дрібку червоного перцю і солі — перець відтіняє, а сіль підсилює шоколадний смак; 4. Влийте решту молока, та перемішайте до загустіння. ⠀ *Не спішіть додавати — крохмаль, напій загусне сам. Але якщо ви хочете отримати більш густий десерт — додайте чайну ложку крохмалю розведену молоком, і продовжуйте мішати. ⠀ 📚Ви можете детально переглянути інші рецепти та сторінки кулінарного блокноту в телеграм-каналі, за посиланням в описі профілю.

videos.caption: 🇸🇪Kladdkaka: easy, quick, gooey, and fantastic chocolate cake! ⬇️⬇️ This is Frederiksfika’s recipe for Kladdkaka, endorsed by IKEA themselves: Ingredients: 200g butter 270g sugar 60g cocoa powder 1/2 tsp salt 3 eggs 90g all purpose flour  A 7-9 inch cake pan (mine is 8) Method: -Preheat oven to 175c/350f and line the pan with parchment, grease the sides  -Melt the butter over low heat, remove from heat -In the same pot, whisk in the sugar, salt, and cocoa until well combined -Whisk in the eggs, one at a time -Fold in flour until fully combined -Pour into pan and bake on the middle rack for 18-25 minutes. Cake should wobble in the center. You can take it out at 18 for a very gooey center but I went for around 23 minutes to get a gooey and dense but not wet center  -Enjoy! #cake #kladdkaka  #internationalfood #ikea

I just wanted to bake chocolate lava cakes... Instead Evelyn cracked me, in more way than one. 🥀🍫😭 #househusbandbakes #evelynchevalier #evelynzzz #animecouplegoals #animetok  This recipe makes 4 chocolate lava cakes.  Ingredients:  • 1/2 cup (4 ounces) unsalted butter, plus more for greasing the ramekins • 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour, plus more for dusting the ramekins • 6 ounces bittersweet or dark chocolate, chopped (about 1 cup plus 1 1/2 tablespoons) You can sub in chocolate chips if its all you have. • 2 large eggs, room temperature • 2 large egg yolks, room temperature • 1/4 cup granulated sugar • 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt Directions:  Gather the ingredients. ● Preheat oven to 450°F. Butter and lightly flour four 6-ounce ramekins. Tap out excess flour. Set the ramekins on a baking sheet. ● Fill a pan/pot with water to a depth of 1 or 2 Inches depending on the depth of the pot; bring to a boil over medium-high and reduce heat to medium-low to maintain a simmer. Combine chocolate and butter in a medium size heatproof bowl and set bowl over simmering water in pan, making sure bottom of bowl doesn't touch water. Cook over medium-low, stirring occasionally and adjusting heat as needed to maintain a simmer, until chocolate mixture is melted and smooth, 10 to 20 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside. ● Beat eggs, egg yolks, sugar, and salt in a medium bowl with an electric mixer fitted with the whisk attachment on high speed until thickened and pale, 2 to 3 minutes ● Whisk melted chocolate until smooth ● Quickly fold melted chocolate mixture and flour into egg mixture in bowl until well combined and no streaks remain. ● Spoon batter into prepared ramekins (about 1/2 cup per ramekin) and smooth the top using a small offset spatula if needed. Place baking sheet with ramekins in the preheated oven; bake until tops of cakes are just set and edges spring back when touched but centers still feel soft, about 9 to 12 minutes. ● Remove cakes from oven and let cool in ramekins on baking sheet for 1 minute. Working with one ramekin at a time, cover ramekin with an inverted plate. Carefully turn over and let stand 10 seconds before lifting the ramekin to unmold cake. Repeat with remaining cakes. Dust with powdered sugar if you want the dominos pizza lavs cake look. Serve immediately or refrigerate for up to 3 days. Microwave briefly to reheat.
